description: This PHP class 'HolidayService' manages holiday data within an HRM system, including searching, caching, and holiday type checks.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Service class for managing holiday data, including search, cache management, and holiday type checks.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HolidayDao instance.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a holiday and clears related cache.

methods.name: getHolidaysCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on date range.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays within a date range with optional pagination.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Returns the count of holidays within a date range.

methods.name: searchHolidaysAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves holidays from cache or calculates and caches them.

methods.name: getCalculatedHolidays
methods.description: Calculates holidays within a date range, including recurring holidays.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a specific day is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays by IDs and clears cache.
